notes: Launcher sections: drag app tiles onto section chips, pick a section and check off apps in a checklist in Launcher Settings to bulk-assign them, and create custom sections. Alt+drag to move any window — hold Alt and drag anywhere on a page and Windows moves it with snap layouts, which also fixes the launcher having no drag region. Now Playing buttons fixed: the player controls now reach inside YouTube Music and Spotify's shadow DOM, so play, pause, next, and previous actually work. Downloads fixed: files downloaded from inside AppMaka were cancelled — popup windows were blanket-banned and the click window was only 3 seconds, so a redirect could expire it. Popups now follow the same click rule as other windows, and the window is 30 seconds. Routines that open nothing now say so instead of failing silently, naming the items that no longer exist. Verified here: 280 automated tests passing, zero clippy warnings on Linux and Windows targets, frontend build clean, Windows installer cross-built and signed on Linux (real-PC test still the gate).
